description: Labeled synthetic benchmark for the structured conflict-detection pipeline (Trust Layer Phase 1). Each case is a pair of claims, each attributed to a different document, with a ground-truth relationship label from the 5-way taxonomy (SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS/COMPLEMENTS/UNRELATED/UNCERTAIN). Grouped into 8 categories per the phase spec: obvious_contradiction, subtle_contradiction, numeric_contradiction, date_contradiction, policy_contradiction, complementary_claims, unrelated_claims, ambiguous_claims.
